framework_min_semantics: fail-closed external pin, no vendor modifications
model_choice: No SST free parameters estimated from clock data in BLIND

gates.name: Protocol and input provenance
gates.required: source hashes, preregistered protocol, unique file IDs

gates.name: Published measurement reconstruction
gates.required: weighted intercrystal standardized offset and published noise scaling

gates.name: Common-mode non-identifiability
gates.required: exact algebraic cancellation of universal S

gates.name: SST-28 local profile internal audit
gates.required: axisym. vorticity zero, profile limits, plateau consistency; separate models

gates.name: Environmental nuisance and crystal transfer
gates.required: two samples sufficient to distinguish environment from clock factor

gates.name: Feedback-only false positive controls
gates.required: closed-loop null with delayed control exhibits bounded or induced oscillatory artifacts

gates.name: Toscani raw periodic search with trials correction
gates.required: source raw, LS periodogram + Monte Carlo max-peak cutoff

gates.name: SST differential prediction
gates.required: parameter-free Th/Yb and two-crystal transfer coefficient and uncertainty

gates.name: Independent dataset replication
gates.required: comparable independently time-resolved public data, no pooled noncontemporaneous series

gates.name: C++ FP64 numerical parity
gates.required: native binary verified, native vs NumPy error <= 1e-11
